Ivy C: Postmortem follow-up for PMTKT-4699. Pattern: repeated leader-election churn during sustained traffic. Need concise runbook edits, owners, and a short checklist for oncall.
Marco S: I'll take ownership of the runbook Quick Triage section. Plan: add 6-step checklist + exact commands and a two-line 'when to escalate' at top. ETA: Tue 2025-07-15.
Tess R: I'll own playbook remediation steps for forced failover and rollback. I'll include precise cordon/drain commands, manual promotion script usage, and safety checks. ETA: Fri 2025-07-11.
Val J: I'll update alerts and add an automated alert workaround: fire if >1 election in 24h OR leader_age > 90s for 10m. Also add alert payload link to runbook. ETA: Thu 2025-07-10.
runbook-bot: PMTKT-4699 created; assign follow-ups: RBK-112, PLB-58, ALERT-734.
Ivy C: Important: capture recurring-incident context (INC-2025-0430 and INC-2025-0389) and add a 'recurring-incident' tag in tickets so we can surface trend reports. Also request 30d retention on leader-election logs.
Marco S: Draft Quick Triage commands (will add to runbook):
`# pod status
kubectl get pods -l app=redwood-shard -o wide
# leader age (promql)
max_over_time(leader_election_age_seconds[1m])
# recent errors
journalctl -u redwood-service --since "45 minutes ago" | rg "leader-election.*fail" -n`
Tess R: Forced failover sequence I'll document: 1) notify infra and oncall, 2) cordon node: `kubectl cordon <node>`, 3) drain with grace: `kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60`, 4) run `scripts/manual_promote.sh --confirm`, 5) verify via leader_age metric and traffic smoke test. Include rollback note.
Val J: I'll add a small playbook note: if >2 failovers in 24h, escalate to platform lead and schedule an after-action review. Also will add a short grep snippet to playbook: `rg "leader-election.*(failed|timeout)" /var/log/redwood/*.log -n`
Ivy C: Action items recap (confirm replies):
- Quick Triage section + commands: Marco S, ETA Tue 2025-07-15 (RBK-112)
- Forced failover + rollback playbook: Tess R, ETA Fri 2025-07-11 (PLB-58)
- Alert rules + runbook links: Val J, ETA Thu 2025-07-10 (ALERT-734)
- Recurring-incident tag + 30d log retention: Ivy C, ETA Wed 2025-07-09
Tess R: :white_check_mark: I'll run the dry-run tabletop with oncall next Wed (2025-07-09) to validate steps.
Marco S: :white_check_mark: I'll add dashboard links (leader_age, failover_count) inline in the runbook.
Val J: :white_check_mark: Filing ALERT-734 now and updating the alert payload templates.
Ivy C: I'll consolidate these into PMTKT-4699 and create a single tracking checklist; target to close items within 14 days.
incident-bot: Severity set to P2 at 1748301234. Reminder: follow-up review in 7 days (1748906034).
